cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: A Valuable Safeguard
cards.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our school trip needs two signatures on every consent form. Keep the children here until I see both; a second check is reassuring.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the only teacher here. Could I check twice instead of waiting for June?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may check again, but it won't replace her signature. Independent eyes are worth the wait.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: June wrote the forms. She says someone else should check her work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She's right. Keep her as the author and find a third person to check. I'll hold departure while you do. We have discovered the safeguard our second safeguard needed.

reason: Let A rule on B proposed duplicate check, then endorse June real independence objection by controlling departure until an additional checker is found.
